Corners & Shots on Target: each team's own recency-weighted+season rate, adjusted by the OPPONENT'S conceding rate vs. league average (a leaky defense really does give up more of both). Cards: each team's own recency-weighted+season YELLOW card rate (red cards excluded entirely — see the page's build notes), with no opponent adjustment — card counts are about a team's own discipline and the referee, not the opponent. Hot Form = average over the last 7 games (can mask a bad most recent game). Real Streak = genuinely CONSECUTIVE recent games clearing the threshold, walking backward from the most recent game. Lines are set automatically below the model's projection for a safety margin. The date filter above only changes what's shown on THIS page (already-fetched matches); it doesn't re-query the API — use --date when running the script to fetch a different window of fixtures.
